title: bridge-state.json (schema 2, contract 1)
description: Written by the G-code bridge every 2 s (1 s with debug on) to 0:/sys/workshop/data/bridge-state.json. Readers: dsf/bridge_contract.py (service), the jog, the live stop, the Services page. Only the keys listed in 'required' are promised; every other key may be added or ignored. Times: use the age of the FILE and the relative *_age_s fields, not the absolute epochs (a browser may read them rounded).

schema.description: Major version of this file. Changes only when a promised key changes meaning or disappears.

contract.description: Version of bridge/CONTRACT.md the bridge was written for. Absent in bridges up to 3.8.0 (read as 1).

time.description: Epoch seconds when the file was written. For people; readers use the file age.

port.description: TCP port the bridge listens on.

error.description: Why the port could not be opened, or null.

pending_orders.description: Non-query lines sent to the machine and not finished.

last_order_age_s.description: Whole seconds since the last non-query line of this client at the moment the file was written; null if none.

end_reason.description: end, cancel, close, disconnect or null.

action.description: Answer to the last action of bridge-action.json: found by its seq.

enabled.description: False: live_stop.py is not installed next to the bridge (no safe stop).
